asked.item: Claude couldn't filter TikTok; is TikTok analytics broken
Can LinkedIn posts be ranked too

verdict.reason: The pages say the MCP tool's platform list is narrower than the platforms Blotato collects analytics for, and that LinkedIn analytics are not available yet.

steps.text: The blotatolisttopposts MCP tool currently ranks posts from Twitter/X, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, and Bluesky.
Use the REST API for top-post rankings on TikTok, YouTube, or Pinterest.
Analytics for LinkedIn are not available yet, so LinkedIn posts will not show metrics.
For LinkedIn, use LinkedIn's native analytics for now.
